name: n8n
verdict: Still the builder's automation tool: cloud Starter is €20 a month billed annually, and you can self-host the community edition.

pricing.price: Royalty-free to self-host for internal or non-commercial use

pros: You pay per workflow run, not per step
Unlimited users on the cloud plans
Community edition is royalty-free for internal use
cons: Business is a big jump and is the self-hosted paid plan
pricingNote: The pricing page shows the annual rates (€20, €50, €667). Monthly amounts and execution caps are in that same page's plan data. Larger Pro and Business execution packs cost more. The community license is the Sustainable Use License on github.com/n8n-io/n8n.
